summary: Iteration 39 testing complete - Tampermonkey Script Outcome Detection Fixes. All 27 backend tests passed (100%). The fix addresses the recurring TM script issue where wins/losses were not being recognized for automated trades. Legacy script v8.8.1 contains: expanded balance selectors (30+), adaptive timing buffers (5s=5000ms, 15s=4000ms, 30s=3500ms), DOM-based result fallback, pre-trade balance comparison fallback. Frontend dashboard loads correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy script v8.8.1 correctly implements detectAccountBalance with 30+ selectors covering PO 2024-2026 layouts
Adaptive timing buffers correctly implemented: 5s trades get 5000ms buffer, 15s get 4000ms, 30s get 3500ms, 60s+ get 3000ms
markTradePending correctly captures balanceBeforeTrade with retry logic (3 attempts) and estimated balance fallback
startOutcomePolling has proper fallback chain: 1) Balance polling, 2) DOM scan via scanDOMForResult(), 3) Pre-trade balance comparison
scanDOMForResult checks closed deals list and popup notifications for win/loss indicators
More polls (30) for 5s trades vs 20 for longer trades to handle PO settlement delays
dom.js module exports getAccountBalance and scanDOMForTradeResult functions for modular script
NOTE: Modular script is v8.8.0 while legacy is v8.8.1 - modular may need rebuild to include latest fixes
